start.blurb: Take the demo for a spin: a stocked shelf of sample words, tags and exercises, with no account attached.
start.title: The whole platform, ready to try.
start.lead: Step into a sample Ladu account. Words in four languages, tags that already group them, and a practice set waiting to run — no sign-up, no setup.

words.title: Every word, four ways.
words.text: Read the same word across English, Deutsch, Español and Eesti.

tags.title: Tags do the sorting.
tags.text: Chapter 1, Kitchen, Exam prep and more — already applied.

practice.title: Practice, already configured.
practice.text: Answer a short exercise set built from your sample words.

start.resetNote: Takes a few minutes · nothing you change is saved
start.languagesHint: Pick 2 or more. The demo shows its sample words in these languages.
start.termsNote: By starting the demo, you confirm that you are at least 13 years old (with a parent's permission if you are under 16) and accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
start.logoutWarning: You are logged in. Starting the demo logs you out of your account.

off.title: The demo is off
off.text: The demo is not available now. You can create a free account instead.

ended.title: The demo has ended
ended.text: All the changes you made in the demo are deleted. Create an account to keep your own words.

errors.demo_busy: Too many demos are running. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.demo_rate_limited: Too many demos were started from your network. Try again later.
errors.demo_unavailable: The demo is not available now. Try again later.
errors.generic: The demo could not start. Try again.
errors.demo_restricted: This is not available in the demo.
errors.demo_word_limit: The demo cannot have more words. Create an account to add more.
errors.demo_tag_limit: The demo cannot have more tags. Create an account to add more.

badge.label: Demo: {{time}} left. Open your account page.

account.title: Demo account
account.text: This is a demo account. When the time ends, the account and all your changes are deleted.
account.namesLocked: A demo account cannot change its name or username.
